{{Quote|Spearmaster Ch'Unkk says&hellip;''"<br />"''No need to ''translate'', you metal toady.|The protocol droid and [[Burr Nolyds]]|<ref name="Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 1">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 1|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 1]]</ref>}}
A [[Color/Legends|silver]] '''protocol droid''' served as a [[Translator/Legends|translator]] for [[Spearmaster]] [[Ch'Unkk]], a [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] who sat on the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Interim Ruling Council]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] witnessed Ch'Unkk get [[Death/Legends|gunned down]] by Council head [[Xandel Carivus]]'s [[Xandel Carivus's Private Guard|Private Guard]].
